spec.title: Strict CSP without console errors on every page
spec.goal: Every Operon page logs browser console errors caused by the backend's Content-Security-Policy: the Google Fonts stylesheet (fonts.googleapis.com) is refused, and an inline <script> in frontend/index.html is refused by script-src 'self'. Make every page load with zero console errors while keeping the CSP strict: never add 'unsafe-inline' or 'unsafe-eval' to script-src. Move the inline script into a same-origin module (or remove it if it is redundant) and either self-host the fonts or allow exactly the needed origins (style-src fonts.googleapis.com, font-src fonts.gstatic.com). Add backend tests that check the CSP header forbids inline scripts and allows only the intended font origins, and that the built index.html contains no inline script.
spec.constraints: Keep the CSP strict. Touch only CSP, index.html, the moved script and tests. All backend tests, frontend tests, typecheck, lint and build must pass.

tasks.title: Locate current CSP definition and inline script in index.html
acceptance: Identify exact file and line ranges where the CSP header is set (expected backend/main.py) and where the inline <script> lives in frontend/index.html.
Confirm script-src currently uses 'self' and note whether fonts.googleapis.com / fonts.gstatic.com are referenced anywhere.
Report the inline script's purpose so the move-or-remove decision is justified.

tasks.title: Move inline script from index.html into a same-origin module
acceptance: frontend/index.html contains no inline <script> element (only module/script tags with src attributes served from same origin).
Any logic from the inline script is preserved in a same-origin module and imported/referenced correctly; if redundant, it is removed with rationale.
No use of 'unsafe-inline' or 'unsafe-eval' anywhere in scripts or CSP.

tasks.title: Resolve Google Fonts CSP block while keeping script-src strict
acceptance: CSP style-src permits exactly the stylesheet origin needed for fonts (fonts.googleapis.com) when self-hosting is not used, or fonts are self-hosted and no external origin is added.
CSP font-src permits exactly the font file origin needed (fonts.gstatic.com) when self-hosting is not used, or fonts are self-hosted and no external origin is added.
script-src remains 'self' with no 'unsafe-inline' and no 'unsafe-eval'.
No unrelated directives are broadened.

tasks.title: Add backend tests asserting CSP strictness and built index.html has no inline script
acceptance: New backend test asserts the CSP response header does not contain 'unsafe-inline' or 'unsafe-eval' within script-src.
New backend test asserts style-src/font-src allow only the intended font origins (or no external font origins if self-hosted), and rejects other origins.
New test asserts the built index.html contains no inline <script> (only script tags with src), skipping gracefully if the build artifact is absent.
All new tests run under the existing backend test command.

tasks.title: Review CSP and inline-script changes for correctness and strictness
acceptance: Diff confirms no 'unsafe-inline'/'unsafe-eval' added to script-src and no unintended origin widening.
Diff confirms inline script removed from frontend/index.html and its behavior preserved or intentionally dropped.
Reviewer records findings with severity and either approves or blocks with specific required fixes.

tasks.title: Security review of CSP directives
acceptance: Confirm script-src is exactly 'self' (no inline/eval/object), and style-src/font-src origins are minimal and justified.
Confirm no other CSP directive regressed in permissiveness.
Report any residual risk or required hardening.

tasks.title: Run backend tests, frontend tests, typecheck/lint, and build
acceptance: Backend test command succeeds including new CSP tests.
Frontend test command succeeds.
Frontend typecheck/lint command succeeds.
Frontend build command succeeds and the produced index.html contains no inline script.

tasks.title: Browser QA: zero console errors on all flows
acceptance: Visit each defined flow path (/, /cases, /analyze, /supervisor) and confirm the expected text renders.
No console errors are logged on any visited page, specifically no CSP refusal for fonts.googleapis.com or inline script.
Screenshots captured for the defined flows.
